editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out that the secret tool you use to talk to ghosts is suddenly gone from history. That is exactly what happens to Nate, Whisper, and Jibanyan when some mean Yo-kai decide to wipe the Yo-kai Watch out of existence. You get to follow Nate on a wild trip 60 years into the past to meet his grandfather, Nathaniel, who was just as much of a handful as Nate is. The vibe is super lighthearted and colorful, making it feel like a giant Saturday morning cartoon that never wants to end. It is all about friendship and the bond between humans and spirits, wrapped in a lot of silly jokes.

The action is fast and the character designs are really cute, which keeps you glued to the screen. While the plot is pretty simple and doesn't have many deep twists, the energy stays high throughout the whole thing. If you have kids or just want something cozy to watch, you will love this. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all those bright colors pop. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for family movie nights.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Nate and his grandfather Nathaniel team up to stop Dame Dedtime and her minions. By using the power of their friendship and the original Yo-kai Watch, they manage to defeat the villains and restore the watch to the timeline. This ensures that humans and Yo-kai can remain friends in the future. Everything goes back to normal, and Nate returns to his own time with a new appreciation for his family history.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute monsters and time travel adventures.
